sections.title: Advanced Computational Biology
sections.description: Advanced Computational Biology will review important concepts for computer science and statistics as they apply to computational biology; discuss current topics and related papers in genomics and computational biology; teach to evaluate, criticize, and summarize research papers in genomics and computational biology; and experiment, evaluate, and try to improve tools/algorithms from topics covered in the course. Requirement: Background in statistics, biology, genetics and genomics, and computer science. Non-GCB students need permission from the instructors.
